scenes.text: This tutorial covers Model Zoo. Browse, verify, download, and benchmark reusable segmentation and classifier models.
Open Model Zoo from the Segmentation models section. Open the catalog and select models compatible with the current task and input channels.
In the main configuration area, review provenance, license, checksum, expected preprocessing, task type, and local availability.

Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. benchmark promising models on a few representative fields before adopting one for a full experiment.
When the workflow finishes, verified model files and benchmark results remain associated with their metadata.
